title: How iFranchise supports investors and brands

segments.text: iFranchise is a franchise consultancy based in Bengaluru, working with investors and business owners across India.
Our work covers franchise selection, model development, partner information, and expansion planning.
For investors, the process starts with your requirements: your budget, preferred city, interests, and how involved you want to be in daily operations.
From there, suitable opportunities can be shortlisted for discussion.
A familiar brand name is only one part of the decision; the business model and your circumstances matter too.
Review the complete investment, including setup costs, fees, and working capital.
Understand who operates the outlet, what support is offered, and which responsibilities remain with you.
Ask the brand for relevant information and clarify the commercial terms.
Before committing, arrange independent legal and financial advice and review the agreement carefully. Business outcomes are never guaranteed.
For business owners, franchising begins with readiness.
Consider whether your economics, operating processes, and customer experience can be repeated consistently beyond your existing locations.
The next step is to define the proposed franchise model, territory approach, partner responsibilities, and support.
These decisions shape the information a prospective franchisee needs to understand.
A clear partner profile and an informative brand listing help start relevant conversations.
Enquiries can then be discussed against the brand's requirements, rather than judged by interest alone.
Training, launch preparation, and ongoing support should be considered from the beginning.
Document the handovers and expectations so both sides understand how the relationship is intended to work.
Throughout the process, iFranchise helps bring investor and brand discussions together, with clear next steps.
We agree the consulting scope around your business and the preparation you need.
Visit iFranchise dot in to explore franchise opportunities, read practical guides, or list your brand.
Contact our team to discuss your requirements.
